C1075.title: Two Sentenced for Installing Covert Camera Equipment in Hotels to Film Guests
C1075.summary: Since March 2021, defendants Yan Mouping and Yan Moujian purchased specialized covert camera equipment from e-commerce platforms and installed it in multiple rooms across three hotels, using a mobile app to remotely watch, replay, and download recordings. A guest discovered the device in a room and reported it on October 7, 2021. The Linwu County People's Court in Hunan convicted both defendants of illegally using covert camera equipment, sentencing Yan Mouping to one year and three months and Yan Moujian to one year in prison.
